description: Adds text to the end of an existing page in the signed-in person's own OneNote. Does not change what is already on the page. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

body.description: Plain text to add at the end of the page.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key on a retry replays the first save without writing twice.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

name: append_to_onenote_page
title: Add to a OneNote page
